sentences.text: Date : 19.05.2023 Heard Mr. AM Ahmed, learned Counsel for the accused petitioner as well as Mr. B Sarma, learned Addl. P.P., Assam for the State respondent.

By this petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the accused-petitioner, namely, Idrish Ali , has prayed for grant of bail in connection with Bongaigaon PS Case Page No.# 2/3 No.130/2023 under Section u/ss 498A/376/506 of the IPC r/w Sections 9/11 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act r/w Section 6 Idrish Ali vs The State Of Assam on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161857580/
1 of POCSO Act.

sentences.text: The FIR reveals the allegation that the informant in this case was married to one Pintu Ghosh who subjected her to cruelty after one year of her marriage.
Thereafter, the said Pintu Ghosh kept her in the rented house of one Sahlim Akhtar where present accused petitioner committed physical relation with her.
It is noticed that the accused petitioner is in judicial custody for 62 days since 17.03.2023.
Mr. A.M. Ahmed, learned counsel for the accused petitioner, submits that the accused has been behind the bar since 17.03.2023, i.e. for 62 days.

Mr. Ahmed further submits that two co-accused persons have already been released on bail by this Court vide order, dated 12.05.2023, passed in Bail Application No. 1435/2023 and Bail Application No.1550/2023.
Therefore, Mr. Ahmed submits that considering the length of detention his prayer for bail may be considered favourably.

Having heard the learned counsel for both sides and on perusal of the FIR, Forwarding report and document annexed with the bail application, it is seen that there is prima facie incriminating materials against the accused petitioner.

However, considering the length of detention and as the co-accused have already been released on bail, maintaining parity in the order, this Court finds that further continuation of detention of the accused petitioner may not be necessary in the interest of the ongoing investigation into the case.

Accordingly, it is provided that the accused petitioner, named above shall be released on bail of Rs.
40,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act) , Bongaigaon subject to the following conditions- :
Page No.# 3/3 (i) That the accused petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer as and when required; and (ii) That the accused petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement,
threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Police Officer or the Court.
This disposes of the bail application.
